fr.english: US land-grant institutions listed by NIFA
fr.translation: Établissements land-grant des États-Unis répertoriés par le NIFA

fr.english: The public directory lists land-grant institutions and links to their websites.
fr.translation: Le répertoire public recense les établissements land-grant et donne les liens vers leurs sites Web.

fr.english: Website reuse terms have not been verified from the public directory page.
fr.translation: Les conditions de réutilisation du site Web n'ont pas été vérifiées à partir de la page du répertoire public.

fr.english: Public directory read without an account. Access to linked institution sites and automated access remain unverified.
fr.translation: Répertoire public consulté sans compte. L'accès aux sites des établissements liés et l'accès automatisé restent non vérifiés.

fr.english: County office locations, current contacts, appointments, fees, advisory services and local crop guidance remain unverified.
fr.translation: Les emplacements des bureaux de comté, les coordonnées actuelles, les rendez-vous, les frais, les services de conseil et les conseils locaux sur les cultures restent à vérifier.

sw.english: US land-grant institutions listed by NIFA
sw.translation: Taasisi za land-grant za Marekani zilizoorodheshwa na NIFA

sw.english: The public directory lists land-grant institutions and links to their websites.
sw.translation: Orodha inayopatikana kwa umma inaonyesha taasisi za land-grant na viungo vya tovuti zao.

sw.english: Website reuse terms have not been verified from the public directory page.
sw.translation: Masharti ya matumizi tena ya tovuti hayajathibitishwa kutoka kwa ukurasa wa orodha ya umma.

sw.english: Public directory read without an account. Access to linked institution sites and automated access remain unverified.
sw.translation: Orodha ya umma imesomwa bila akaunti. Ufikiaji wa tovuti za taasisi zilizounganishwa na ufikiaji wa kiotomatiki bado havijathibitishwa.

sw.english: County office locations, current contacts, appointments, fees, advisory services and local crop guidance remain unverified.
sw.translation: Maeneo ya ofisi za kaunti, mawasiliano ya sasa, miadi, ada, huduma za ushauri na mwongozo wa mazao ya eneo husika bado havijathibitishwa.
